name: Kogarashi Saburou
source: A timid young man who spends most of his time indoors, even taking his college classes remotely. He's extremely nervous in social situations; just making eye contact with another person is enough to make him start trembling. Surprisingly, he's actually a member of an extracurricular club. Unsurprisingly, he only participates in the group chat and never goes to meetings in person.
